gold: congenital unilateral hypoplasia of depressor anguli oris

selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of facial asymmetry and right lower lip deviation inward when smiling or crying are most consistent with Congenital unilateral lower lip palsy, which specifically affects the lower lip.

rejected.label: Moebius syndrome
rejected.why: Moebius syndrome typically involves more widespread facial paralysis and often affects the eyes, which is not noted in this patient.

rejected.label: Isolated congenital facial paresis
rejected.why: While this could be a consideration, the specific involvement of the lower lip points more towards Congenital unilateral lower lip palsy.
